s0401.literal: Duodu, Wang Shixi, and twelve others were summoned from their places of exile and released to return to their native districts.
s0401.idiomatic: Duodu, Wang Shixi, and 12 others were summoned from their places of exile and released to return to their native districts.

s0402.literal: On gengxu day, because the ceremony of the Emperor's personal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed, an edict was issued throughout the realm.
s0402.idiomatic: On gengxu day, because the ceremony of the Emperor's personal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed, an edict was issued throughout the realm.

s0403.literal: Corvée labor on the Great Monastery of Supporting Heaven and Protecting Sagacity was abolished.
s0403.idiomatic: Corvée labor on the Great Monastery of Supporting Heaven and Protecting Sagacity was abolished.

s0404.literal: Prisoners who had been imprisoned for three years on charges that could not be resolved were released.
s0404.idiomatic: Prisoners who had been imprisoned for 3 years on charges that could not be resolved were released.

s0405.literal: Arrears of official debts owed by the populace that could not be recovered were entirely remitted.
s0405.idiomatic: Arrears of official debts owed by the populace that could not be recovered were entirely remitted.

s0406.literal: Transmission Court officials were ordered to divide duties and go to the relevant offices in each locality to jointly recruit replacement relay households for those who had fled.
s0406.idiomatic: Transmission Court officials were ordered to divide duties and go to the relevant offices in each locality to jointly recruit replacement relay households for those who had fled.

s0407.literal: At relay stations from Dadu to Shangdu, including Tasihala, Xumaiqie, and others, where relay households supplied their own shisi and the burden of provision was heavy, in the third year of Tianli the government was to provide for them.
s0407.idiomatic: At relay stations from Dadu to Shangdu, including Tasihala, Xumaiqie, and others, where relay households supplied their own shisi and the burden of provision was heavy, in the third year of Tianli the government was to provide for them.

s0408.literal: Commercial taxes among the populace of Fengyuan Route were exempted for one year; the relevant offices in each locality were ordered to establish ever-normal granaries.
s0408.idiomatic: Commercial taxes among the populace of Fengyuan Route were exempted for 1 year; the relevant offices in each locality were ordered to establish ever-normal granaries.

s0409.literal: Those among Yunnan's Eight Fan who had been implicated by Nangjiatai and remained unsettled in rebellion were all granted redemption of their crimes.
s0409.idiomatic: Those among Yunnan's Eight Fan who had been implicated by Nangjiatai and remained unsettled in rebellion were all granted redemption of their crimes.

s0410.literal: Miscellaneous corvée and labor services of salt-boiling households at every locality were exempted for two years.
s0410.idiomatic: Miscellaneous corvée and labor services of salt-boiling households at every locality were exempted for 2 years.

s0411.literal: Envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial duties by proxy at the mountains, rivers, and waterways.
s0411.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial duties by proxy at the mountains, rivers, and waterways.

s0412.literal: Rent on fields of the Yongping Field-agriculture Metropolitan Commission was remitted, and a renewed prohibition was issued throughout the realm against private slaughter of horses and cattle.
s0412.idiomatic: Rent on fields of the Yongping Field-agriculture Metropolitan Commission was remitted, and a renewed prohibition was issued throughout the realm against private slaughter of horses and cattle.

s0413.literal: Mingzong's wet nurse's husband Ordo, who under Wuzong had been grand preceptor, had his seal confiscated under Renzong.
s0413.idiomatic: Mingzong's wet nurse's husband Ordo, who under Wuzong had been grand preceptor, had his seal confiscated under Renzong.

s0414.literal: Yan Temür spoke on his behalf; an edict ordered it returned to him.
s0414.idiomatic: Yan Temür spoke on his behalf; an edict ordered it returned to him.

s0415.literal: Aifang, native official of Huang Prefecture on Weichu Route in Yunnan, dispatched his son to come to court in tribute.
s0415.idiomatic: Aifang, native official of Huang Prefecture on Weichu Route in Yunnan, dispatched his son to come to court in tribute.

s0416.literal: Changde, Wuchang, Lizhou, and other routes in Huguang suffered drought and famine; official grain was released to sell relief grain.
s0416.idiomatic: Changde, Wuchang, Lizhou, and other routes in Huguang suffered drought and famine; official grain was released to sell relief grain.

s0417.literal: In Shaanxi, forty-seven thousand famine-stricken households in Fengxiang Prefecture were all granted relief in notes.
s0417.idiomatic: In Shaanxi, 47,000 famine-stricken households in Fengxiang Prefecture were all granted relief in notes.

s0418.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day, because the empress was installed, an edict was issued throughout the realm.
s0418.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on yimao day, because the empress was installed, an edict was issued throughout the realm.

s0419.literal: The Emperor received Buddhist precepts from the Imperial Preceptor, and Buddhist rites were performed for sixty days.
s0419.idiomatic: The Emperor received Buddhist precepts from the Imperial Preceptor, and Buddhist rites were performed for 60 days.

s0420.literal: On bingchen day Prince of Jurong Commandery Dali was made to administer privy council affairs.
s0420.idiomatic: On bingchen day Prince of Jurong Commandery Dali was made to administer privy council affairs.

s0421.literal: An edict ordered that attendant ministers of empresses and consorts in the palaces of successive sagely emperors be permanently granted clothing allowances, salary grain, and fodder grain.
s0421.idiomatic: An edict ordered that attendant ministers of empresses and consorts in the palaces of successive sagely emperors be permanently granted clothing allowances, salary grain, and fodder grain.

s0422.literal: Later Empress Babusha requested to accumulate otherworldly merit for Mingzong; the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to lead the assembly of monks in performing Buddhist rites for seven days at the Great Heavenly Source Extended Sagacity Monastery; Taoist priests performed jiao liturgies at the four palaces of Jade Void, Heavenly Treasure, Grand Ultimate, and Longevity, and at the two mountains of Wudang and Longhu.
s0422.idiomatic: Later Empress Babusha requested to accumulate otherworldly merit for Mingzong; the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to lead the assembly of monks in performing Buddhist rites for 7 days at the Great Heavenly Source Extended Sagacity Monastery; Taoist priests performed jiao liturgies at the 4 palaces of Jade Void, Heavenly Treasure, Grand Ultimate, and Longevity, and at the 2 mountains of Wudang and Longhu.

s0423.literal: On wuwu day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial duties by proxy to the Heavenly Consort.
s0423.idiomatic: On wuwu day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial duties by proxy to the Heavenly Consort.

s0424.literal: A residence was granted to Yan Temür.
s0424.idiomatic: A residence was granted to Yan Temür.

s0425.literal: The empress contributed fifty thousand taels of silver to assist in building the Great Monastery of Supporting Heaven and Protecting Sagacity.
s0425.idiomatic: The empress contributed 50,000 taels of silver to assist in building the Great Monastery of Supporting Heaven and Protecting Sagacity.

s0427.literal: Doerzhi Yidu was appointed chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat.
s0427.idiomatic: Doerzhi Yidu was appointed chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat.

s0428.literal: Under recent regulations branch secretariats were not to have chancellors; the central secretariat spoke on the matter; the Emperor had an instruction: "Doerzhi is an old minister of the prior court and ought not be bound by precedent.
s0428.idiomatic: Under recent regulations branch secretariats were not to have chancellors; the central secretariat spoke on the matter; the Emperor had an instruction: "Doerzhi is an old minister of the prior court and ought not be bound by precedent.

s0429.literal: " Yearly grants to Wuzong's guard soldiers were to follow the precedent of Renzong's guard soldiers.
s0429.idiomatic: Yearly grants to Wuzong's guard soldiers were to follow the precedent of Renzong's guard soldiers.

s0430.literal: The Tangut monk commander-in-chief, enfeoffed Duke of the State Chongbu, died; his younger brother Jianzang Banzangbu succeeded to the post, and imperial patent documents and seals were still granted to him.
s0430.idiomatic: The Tangut monk commander-in-chief, enfeoffed Duke of the State Chongbu, died; his younger brother Jianzang Banzangbu succeeded to the post, and imperial patent documents and seals were still granted to him.

s0431.literal: On guihai day Hanlin academician exemplar Kuochebo was made privy council administrator, ranking above the other privy council administrators.
s0431.idiomatic: On guihai day Hanlin academician exemplar Kuochebo was made privy council administrator, ranking above the other privy council administrators.

s0432.literal: On jiazi day Luzhou suffered drought and famine; five thousand shi of grain were released for relief.
s0432.idiomatic: On jiazi day Luzhou suffered drought and famine; 5,000 shi of grain were released for relief.

s0433.literal: Hunting within the capital region by the falconry bureau was stopped.
s0433.idiomatic: Hunting within the capital region by the falconry bureau was stopped.

s0434.literal: Longxing, Nankang, Fu, Rui, Yuan, and Ji routes in Jiangxi suffered drought.
s0434.idiomatic: Longxing, Nankang, Fu, Rui, Yuan, and Ji routes in Jiangxi suffered drought.

s0435.literal: On bingyin day the rank of the Shandong-Hebei Mongol Army Metropolitan Commander-in-Chief's Office was raised to 2b.
s0435.idiomatic: On bingyin day the rank of the Shandong-Hebei Mongol Army Metropolitan Commander-in-Chief's Office was raised to 2b.

s0436.literal: The Puqing Monastery-repair artisan intendant office was changed to a Construction Superintendent Agency, rank 5b, subordinate to the Chongxiang Metropolitan Commission.
s0436.idiomatic: The Puqing Monastery-repair artisan intendant office was changed to a Construction Superintendent Agency, rank 5b, subordinate to the Chongxiang Metropolitan Commission.

s0437.literal: Nifang, native official of Weichu Route in Yunnan, came to court in tribute.
s0437.idiomatic: Nifang, native official of Weichu Route in Yunnan, came to court in tribute.

s0438.literal: The Merit Commissionerate was abolished, and the affairs under its charge were returned to the Bureau for Buddhist Affairs.
s0438.idiomatic: The Merit Commissionerate was abolished, and the affairs under its charge were returned to the Bureau for Buddhist Affairs.

s0439.literal: On jisi day Sadi was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.
s0439.idiomatic: On jisi day Sadi was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.

s0440.literal: Central secretariat left vice chancellor Zhao Shi'an was ordered to supervise the Directorate of Education and the National University.
s0440.idiomatic: Central secretariat left vice chancellor Zhao Shi'an was ordered to supervise the Directorate of Education and the National University.

s0441.literal: On gengwu day Prince Kuobuhua arrived from Shaanxi; his seal was confiscated and he was sent back.
s0441.idiomatic: On gengwu day Prince Kuobuhua arrived from Shaanxi; his seal was confiscated and he was sent back.

s0442.literal: On renshen day the seal of Prince of Guangping Mulahu was destroyed; Haban was ordered to replace him, and a newly cast seal was granted.
s0442.idiomatic: On renshen day the seal of Prince of Guangping Mulahu was destroyed; Haban was ordered to replace him, and a newly cast seal was granted.

s0443.literal: On guiyou day the moon violated Saturn.
s0443.idiomatic: On guiyou day the moon violated Saturn.

s0444.literal: On bingzi day Prince Alaqtenashiri, having toiled in supporting the enthronement, was given his father's Prince of Yue Toghto's seal.
s0444.idiomatic: On bingzi day Prince Alaqtenashiri, having toiled in supporting the enthronement, was given his father's Prince of Yue Toghto's seal.

s0445.literal: On dingchou day the Mengding Route Military-Civil Metropolitan Commission was re-established, and the seal of the Yuanjiang Route Military-Civil Metropolitan Commission was restored.
s0445.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Mengding Route Military-Civil Metropolitan Commission was re-established, and the seal of the Yuanjiang Route Military-Civil Metropolitan Commission was restored.

s0446.literal: Two hundred eighty-odd prefectures and counties in Huguang that had been plundered by bandits of the Guangyuan and other Yao peoples were ordered to be recruited and captured by branch secretariat grand councillor Liu Toghan.
s0446.idiomatic: 280-odd prefectures and counties in Huguang that had been plundered by bandits of the Guangyuan and other Yao peoples were ordered to be recruited and captured by branch secretariat grand councillor Liu Toghan.

s0447.literal: Ten thousand bluish cotton garments were manufactured and granted to the encircling-guard army.
s0447.idiomatic: 10,000 bluish cotton garments were manufactured and granted to the encircling-guard army.

s0448.literal: On yimao day Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy officials said: "In compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Yingzong, we request that Doresh's written confession be prepared and delivered to the historiography office.
s0448.idiomatic: On yimao day Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy officials said: "In compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Yingzong, we request that Doresh's written confession be prepared and delivered to the historiography office.

s0450.literal: The King of Goryeo Wang Chon had long been ill and could not attend court; he requested that his son Wang Zhen be ordered to succeed to the position.
s0450.idiomatic: The King of Goryeo Wang Chon had long been ill and could not attend court; he requested that his son Wang Zhen be ordered to succeed to the position.

s0451.literal: One hundred fifty qing of official fields at Pingjiang were granted to the Great Dragon Soaring Jiqing Monastery and the Great Great Blessing Longevity Monastery.
s0451.idiomatic: 150 qing of official fields at Pingjiang were granted to the Great Dragon Soaring Jiqing Monastery and the Great Great Blessing Longevity Monastery.

s0452.literal: On xinsi day the Shandong-Hebei Mongol Army Metropolitan Commander-in-Chief's Office was relocated to Puzhou; the Shandong surveillance commission was still permitted to investigate and adjudicate.
s0452.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Shandong-Hebei Mongol Army Metropolitan Commander-in-Chief's Office was relocated to Puzhou; the Shandong surveillance commission was still permitted to investigate and adjudicate.

s0453.literal: The Kipchak Guard was made to concurrently hold the post of right capital guard commissioner.
s0453.idiomatic: The Kipchak Guard was made to concurrently hold the post of right capital guard commissioner.

s0454.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri to garrison Yunnan; his guard soldiers were granted ten thousand ingots of notes, and their clothing allowances were still to be supplied in advance each year.
s0454.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri to garrison Yunnan; his guard soldiers were granted 10,000 ingots of notes, and their clothing allowances were still to be supplied in advance each year.

s0455.literal: Twelfth month, on jiaxu day the prince tutor seal was granted to Prince of Bin Qota Temür Misi; the Western monk Nianzhen Chilasi was made Imperial Preceptor.
s0455.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on jiaxu day the prince tutor seal was granted to Prince of Bin Qota Temür Misi; the Western monk Nianzhen Chilasi was made Imperial Preceptor.

s0456.literal: An edict ordered that monks and nuns be entirely exempt from corvée and labor services.
s0456.idiomatic: An edict ordered that monks and nuns be entirely exempt from corvée and labor services.

s0457.literal: On bingxu day an edict ordered that officials of first through third grade first speak on one matter of gain or loss in court governance;
s0457.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict ordered that officials of first through third grade first speak on one matter of gain or loss in court governance;

s0458.literal: those of fourth grade and below were entirely permitted to set forth their views.
s0458.idiomatic: those of fourth grade and below were entirely permitted to set forth their views.

s0459.literal: They were still ordered that Zhao Shi'an and Arong compile the memorials submitted; good ones were immediately deliberated and implemented.
s0459.idiomatic: They were still ordered that Zhao Shi'an and Arong compile the memorials submitted; good ones were immediately deliberated and implemented.

s0460.literal: Posthumous enfeoffment was granted to Yan Temür's great-grandfather Bandudaci as Prince of Liyang, his grandfather Tutuha as Prince of Sheng, and his father Chengge as Prince of Yang.
s0460.idiomatic: Posthumous enfeoffment was granted to Yan Temür's great-grandfather Bandudaci as Prince of Liyang, his grandfather Tutuha as Prince of Sheng, and his father Chengge as Prince of Yang.

s0461.literal: On gengyin day purification sacrifices were performed at Taizu's tent hall.
s0461.idiomatic: On gengyin day purification sacrifices were performed at Taizu's tent hall.

s0463.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Under the old system, whenever there was a memorial, after discussion all were to jointly sign before entering to memorialize.
s0463.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Under the old system, whenever there was a memorial, after discussion all were to jointly sign before entering to memorialize.

s0464.literal: In recent years, while matters were still under deliberation, one or two secretariat ministers rashly submitted requests, causing many discrepancies and delays.
s0464.idiomatic: In recent years, while matters were still under deliberation, 1 or 2 secretariat ministers rashly submitted requests, causing many discrepancies and delays.

s0465.literal: Now we request that the old system be followed.
s0465.idiomatic: Now we request that the old system be followed.

s0466.literal: " Censorate officials said: "When censorate officials take up their posts, without regard to distance, equal provision of relay should be appropriate.
s0466.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "When censorate officials take up their posts, without regard to distance, equal provision of relay should be appropriate.

s0468.literal: On xinmao day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to lead his disciples in performing Buddhist rites at the Ninghui Pavilion.
s0468.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to lead his disciples in performing Buddhist rites at the Ninghui Pavilion.

s0469.literal: On jiawu day Jining Route suffered drought and famine; two thousand nine hundred shi of grain were granted for relief.
s0469.idiomatic: On jiawu day Jining Route suffered drought and famine; 2,900 shi of grain were granted for relief.

s0470.literal: On yiwei day former Prince of Zhennan Temurbuqa was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Xuanrang.
s0470.idiomatic: On yiwei day former Prince of Zhennan Temurbuqa was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Xuanrang.

s0471.literal: Initially, Prince of Zhennan Tobuhua died; his son Bolobuqa was young, and Temurbuqa was ordered to inherit the title.
s0471.idiomatic: Initially, Prince of Zhennan Tobuhua died; his son Bolobuqa was young, and Temurbuqa was ordered to inherit the title.

s0472.literal: Once Bolobuqa had grown up, Temurbuqa requested that the princely title be returned to him; thereupon he was specially enfeoffed Prince of Xuanrang to show favor and reward.
s0472.idiomatic: Once Bolobuqa had grown up, Temurbuqa requested that the princely title be returned to him; thereupon he was specially enfeoffed Prince of Xuanrang to show favor and reward.

s0473.literal: The gold seal of Prince Tegus was confiscated.
s0473.idiomatic: The gold seal of Prince Tegus was confiscated.

s0474.literal: An edict instructed the court ministers: "Imperial paternal aunt, Grand Elder Princess of Lu State, widowed early and preserved chastity, did not follow her uncles' urging to remarry, reared the orphaned child, whose son inherited the princely title, and whose daughter was matched to Us.
s0474.idiomatic: An edict instructed the court ministers: "Imperial paternal aunt, Grand Elder Princess of Lu State, widowed early and preserved chastity, did not follow her uncles' urging to remarry, reared the orphaned child, whose son inherited the princely title, and whose daughter was matched to Us.

s0475.literal: We consider that commoners who did thus should still be commended — how much more so one of honored kin?
s0475.idiomatic: We consider that commoners who did thus should still be commended — how much more so one of honored kin?

s0476.literal: Zhao Shiyan, Yu Ji, and others may deliberate on an enfeoffment title and report.
s0476.idiomatic: Zhao Shiyan, Yu Ji, and others may deliberate on an enfeoffment title and report.

s0477.literal: " An edict: "Monastic temple lands, whether held since Jin and Song times or granted over successive reigns, shall all have their rent remitted.
s0477.idiomatic: An edict: "Monastic temple lands, whether held since Jin and Song times or granted over successive reigns, shall all have their rent remitted.

s0478.literal: Where rent still ought to be paid, corvée is still to be exempted.
s0478.idiomatic: Where rent still ought to be paid, corvée is still to be exempted.

s0479.literal: Monks who returned to lay life may again become monks.
s0479.idiomatic: Monks who returned to lay life may again become monks.

s0480.literal: " On wuxu day sixty thousand salt certificates of the Huai-Zhe, Shandong, and Hejian four transport commissions were granted as bath-and-fief revenue for the Grand Elder Princess of Lu State.
s0480.idiomatic: On wuxu day 60,000 salt certificates of the Huai-Zhe, Shandong, and Hejian 4 transport commissions were granted as bath-and-fief revenue for the Grand Elder Princess of Lu State.

s0481.literal: On jihai day envoys were dispatched by post to convey the former Imperial Preceptor's relics back to his country, granting five hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, one thousand five hundred ingots of notes, and five thousand bolts of silks.
s0481.idiomatic: On jihai day envoys were dispatched by post to convey the former Imperial Preceptor's relics back to his country, granting 500 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, 1,500 ingots of notes, and 5,000 bolts of silks.

s0482.literal: The posthumous title was advanced for Han Prince of Changsha Wu Rui to Prince Wen and Kind of Changsha.
s0482.idiomatic: The posthumous title was advanced for Han Prince of Changsha Wu Rui to Prince Wen and Kind of Changsha.

s0483.literal: On renyin day the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to print twenty-seven collections of Buddhist scriptures.
s0483.idiomatic: On renyin day the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to print 27 collections of Buddhist scriptures.

s0484.literal: On guimao day Qizhou Route suffered drought and famine in summer and autumn; five thousand shi of rice were granted for relief.
s0484.idiomatic: On guimao day Qizhou Route suffered drought and famine in summer and autumn; 5,000 shi of rice were granted for relief.

s0485.literal: On jiachen day, because the first month of the following year was Wuzong's death anniversary, three hundred forty Goryeo and Han monks were ordered to pre-recite two collections of Buddhist scriptures at the Great Monastery of Great Blessing, Fortune, and Primordial Origin.
s0485.idiomatic: On jiachen day, because the first month of the following year was Wuzong's death anniversary, 340 Goryeo and Han monks were ordered to pre-recite 2 collections of Buddhist scriptures at the Great Monastery of Great Blessing, Fortune, and Primordial Origin.

s0486.literal: On dingwei day four hundred fifty thousand ingots of Zhiyuan notes and fifty thousand ingots of Zhongtong notes were manufactured, as in the yearly precedent.
s0486.idiomatic: On dingwei day 450,000 ingots of Zhiyuan notes and 50,000 ingots of Zhongtong notes were manufactured, as in the yearly precedent.

s0487.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Within the capital there are fifty-four distilleries, yielding over one hundred thousand ingots in yearly tax.
s0487.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Within the capital there are 54 distilleries, yielding over 100,000 ingots in yearly tax.

s0488.literal: Recently some have been granted in intervals to princes, princesses, and various official temples; princes and princesses have their own fiefs and yearly grants, and official temples each have fixed endowments — it would be fitting that distillery taxes all still be submitted to the government as before.
s0488.idiomatic: Recently some have been granted in intervals to princes, princesses, and various official temples; princes and princesses have their own fiefs and yearly grants, and official temples each have fixed endowments — it would be fitting that distillery taxes all still be submitted to the government as before.

s0490.literal: The wine prohibition was lifted in Hedong Jining Route and Sichuan Chongqing Route.
s0490.idiomatic: The wine prohibition was lifted in Hedong Jining Route and Sichuan Chongqing Route.

s0491.literal: The Tubo patrol metropolitan marshal's office was abolished.
s0491.idiomatic: The Tubo patrol metropolitan marshal's office was abolished.

s0492.literal: Relief was granted for three months' grain to twenty-two hundred-odd households of the Shangdu Commissionerate's Balakhachi and eight hundred-odd households of Zhulachi, with notes according to difference;
s0492.idiomatic: Relief was granted for 3 months' grain to 2,200-odd households of the Shangdu Commissionerate's Balakhachi and 800-odd households of Zhulachi, with notes according to difference;

s0493.literal: the eight hundred seventy households of the falconry bureau at Yalian Tu Jieludie's residence received three months' grain.
s0493.idiomatic: the 870 households of the falconry bureau at Yalian Tu Jieludie's residence received 3 months' grain.

s0494.literal: On wushen day Yuelu Buhua was made censor-in-chief, concurrently in charge of Longxiang Metropolitan Commission affairs.
s0494.idiomatic: On wushen day Yuelu Buhua was made censor-in-chief, concurrently in charge of Longxiang Metropolitan Commission affairs.

s0495.literal: On gengxu day an edict ordered that Central Domestic Affairs Court affairs be actively pursued.
s0495.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict ordered that Central Domestic Affairs Court affairs be actively pursued.

s0496.literal: On xinhai day those within and without the capital who had already received appointments were urgently ordered to proceed quickly to their posts.
s0496.idiomatic: On xinhai day those within and without the capital who had already received appointments were urgently ordered to proceed quickly to their posts.

s0497.literal: Steamed-bun Mountain at Shangdu was renamed Tianli Mountain.
s0497.idiomatic: Steamed-bun Mountain at Shangdu was renamed Tianli Mountain.

s0498.literal: On renzi day Wuzong's imperial portrait was woven; Buddhist rites were immediately performed at the spirit hall.
s0498.idiomatic: On renzi day Wuzong's imperial portrait was woven; Buddhist rites were immediately performed at the spirit hall.

s0499.literal: An edict: "All those whose rank is ceremonial standing equal to the Three Excellencies shall in court ranks stand before first grade.
s0499.idiomatic: An edict: "All those whose rank is ceremonial standing equal to the Three Excellencies shall in court ranks stand before first grade.

s0500.literal: " Jiangxia County in Wuchang Prefecture suffered fire; two hundred seventy impoverished households were granted one month's grain in relief.
s0500.idiomatic: Jiangxia County in Wuchang Prefecture suffered fire; 270 impoverished households were granted 1 month's grain in relief.
